prov.text: The period-end allowance for credit losses was $23.2 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to $23.9 million at the prior quarter-end. The ratio of the allowance to total loans decreased to 1.03% from 1.06% for these dates.

nonint.heading: NON-INTEREST EXPENSE
nonint.text:
Total non-interest expense decreased $121 thousand, or 1%, to $19.4 million in the third quarter of 2026.

Salaries and benefits increased $235 thousand, or 2%, including $77 thousand from the expense related to the new stock grants issued.

Modest decreases were recorded across many of the other expense categories.

nonop.heading: NON-INTEREST EXPENSE
nonop.text:
Total non-interest expense decreased $121 thousand, or 1%, to $19.4 million in the third quarter of 2026.

Salaries and benefits increased $235 thousand, or 2%, including $77 thousand from the expense related to the new stock grants issued.

Modest decreases were recorded across many of the other expense categories.

tax.heading: INCOME TAXES
tax.text:
Income tax expense increased $660 thousand to $3.0 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the prior quarter.

The effective income tax rate was 25.6% for the third quarter and 25.5% year-to-date.

net sales.heading: REVENUE
net sales.text:
Total net revenue increased to $31.2 million in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $1.3 million, or 4%, compared to the prior quarter.

Third quarter 2026 net interest income increased $1.5 million due to higher interest rates across most loan categories. The net interest margin improved by 22 basis points to 3.86%, which included a large $692 thousand loan prepayment penalty received from the prepayment of the large solar loan mentioned above. The net interest margin excluding the prepayment penalty is 3.75%, up 11 basis points from the second quarter.

Average earning assets totaled $2.6 billion, which remained steady from the prior quarter.

The yield on earning assets increased 21 basis points to 5.26%. The 5.55% loan yield included the $692 thousand in prepayment penalties, which contributed 12 basis points to the loan yield.

The cost of interest-bearing liabilities decreased 1 basis point to 1.88%, as the benefit from lower cost borrowings was partially offset by a 3 basis point increase in the cost of deposits to 1.35%.

Non-interest income decreased by $250 thousand, primarily because payments processing income declined from the prior quarter, when it was elevated by contract termination fees.

Mortgage banking income increased $149 thousand, or 51.9%, primarily driven by a higher quarterly MSR valuation.

Deposits.text: Lower cost transaction accounts (demand and NOW) were 50% of period-end total deposits.

Securities.text: Total investment securities decreased by $1.7 million from June 30, to $325.9 million.

Payments processing.text: Non-interest income decreased by $250 thousand, primarily because payments processing income declined from the prior quarter, when it was elevated by contract termination fees.

intro.text: Avidia Bancorp, Inc. is the bank holding company of Avidia Bank. Avidia Bank is a Massachusetts-chartered stock savings bank. With headquarters in Hudson, Massachusetts, it also operates nine full-service banking offices in western Middlesex County and eastern Worcester County, in Massachusetts
